title: Military members saw football-field-size triangular craft

tellings.quote: I remember sort of interviewing some military members that saw some really profound stuff like, you know, large, you know, triangular crafts, you know, football field size that, you know, hovered over them.

plain: A man named David Grusch says that, at some point around 2019 to 2021, he interviewed military members in the United States who told him they had seen something remarkable. According to Grusch, they described large triangular craft, as big as a football field, hovering right above them. He tells it as an example of the kind of first-hand accounts he heard, which if true would mean huge unknown craft are flying over American service members.
